capabilities: Generate link buttons from frontmatter account descriptions
Configure service names, base colors, and URI/account name substitution rules
Support URI schemes such as mailto: and obsidian://
disambiguation: Not an account manager or sync tool; it only renders links from frontmatter values.
extras: The README's Example section (input, preview, settings) has no visible content, and a TODO lists planned features like favicon support and reverse-generating account names from URIs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn frontmatter entries about external service accounts into clickable links or buttons.
summary: Renders link buttons for external service accounts declared in a note's frontmatter, with configurable URI substitution rules.
